status: FROZEN before any Civil Comments evaluator score has been analyzed with respect to the identity attributes A, and before any Civil Comments LLM API call

study_status.persuade: original preregistered/confirmatory case study per its existing provenance (config/preregistered.json); NOT modified by this addendum
study_status.civil_comments_detoxify: additional audit separately frozen at commit 861804b25f1afd8c81eb26d3e5bb35e2d4bec5a6; score store frozen A-blind at commit 510ece882ff119bdd459b8ab3df7a51353a2d67c; its eight-test confirmatory family and Holm correction are NOT modified by this addendum
study_status.llm_extension: secondary cross-evaluator replication family, designed and frozen BEFORE any Civil Comments evaluator score (Detoxify or LLM) was joined to A or Z; not part of the original PERSUADE preregistration and not part of the original Civil Comments primary confirmatory family

evaluators.note: exact frozen model IDs reused verbatim from the PERSUADE preregistration (config/preregistered.json, judge.primary and judge.secondary); no substitution permitted -- if any exact model is uncallable at scoring time, STOP for a documented public amendment

settings.temperature: 0 attempted; omitted once and recorded if the API rejects the parameter (frozen PERSUADE fallback)

settings.seed: not offered by the Messages API; recorded per record as seed_supported: false

settings.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel: low (the frozen PERSUADE-approved minimum-thinking setting; billed thinking tokens recorded per record)
settings.responseSchema: OBJECT{score: INTEGER}; range enforcement to 1..5 is the strict parser's job

prompt.rendering: the literal placeholder line token [[COMMENT_TEXT]] is replaced by the raw comment_text string exactly as stored in the frozen dataset (empty string allowed); no other transformation; the rendered prompt is byte-identical across the three providers; per-item rendered-prompt SHA-256 is recorded in each raw record
prompt.type: STANDARD toxicity rubric; deliberately contains NO instruction about identity, demographics, protected characteristics, bias, or fairness
prompt.no_variants: no other prompt, mitigation wording, or paraphrase may be scored under this addendum

inputs_to_llm: comment_id (request routing only; not in prompt text)
never_sent: any aggregate of A or Z
information_barrier.smoke_tests: credential/availability smoke calls use fixed non-dataset sentences only

sample.rule: exactly the frozen one-comment-per-article primary manifest; the full 448,000-comment census is NOT scored by the LLM evaluators
sample.concurrency: ThreadPoolExecutor with 10 workers per provider (the frozen PERSUADE scoring concurrency); providers may run concurrently with each other
sample.storage: offcriterion.pipeline.storage.RawScoreStore (append-only JSONL, refuse-overwrite, freeze() writes SHA-256 manifest, analysis requires verify_frozen()) under data/scoring/cc_<provider>_toxicity

retry_and_exclusion.retry_policy: up to 3 retries of the identical request on HTTP 429/5xx/network errors with exponential backoff (2^retries + U(0,1) seconds); any other 4xx aborts the run for report (frozen PERSUADE policy, reused)
retry_and_exclusion.technical_failure: an item still failing after the frozen retry policy is a technical exclusion, logged per comment id, never re-scored
retry_and_exclusion.unparseable_response: excluded and logged; the response must parse as a JSON object with the single key 'score' and an integer value 1..5; no repair, no reprompt (offcriterion.pipeline.cc_toxicity_judges.parse_toxicity_score)
retry_and_exclusion.no_selective_rescoring: no item is ever re-scored because its score looks unusual; resumption after a crash may only fill comment ids absent from the append-only store

analysis.s: the frozen integer 1-5 toxicity rating used directly; no discretization (s_bin = score - 1, n_s_bins = 5); the same integer on the 1-5 scale is the raw scale for the descriptive gap
analysis.a_rule: identical to the frozen Civil Comments rule: A = 1 iff stored identity fraction >= 1/2 under exact rational comparison (scripts/civil_comments_freeze.py attribute_value)
analysis.z_primary: identical exact seven-label human annotation vector (toxicity, severe_toxicity, identity_attack, insult, threat, obscene, sexual_explicit), exact rational stratum keys (z_key_exact)
analysis.sample: frozen one-comment-per-article manifest, restricted per evaluator to its validly scored comments; technical/invalid exclusions are dropped and reported, never imputed
analysis.descriptive_gap: stratum-size-weighted conditional mean difference on the original 1-5 score scale, sign = mean(S|A=1) - mean(S|A=0), same conditional weighting rule as the frozen Detoxify analysis (weighted_mean_gap)

seeds.scheme: numpy.random.SeedSequence(entropy=20260827, spawn_key=(analysis_slot, identity_index)); identity_index from the frozen identity order
seeds.no_collision: slots 1-5 and 9 belong to the frozen Detoxify analysis and are not reused

multiplicity.detoxify_family: UNCHANGED: eight WILDS identity tests, Holm across those eight raw permutation p-values (frozen at 861804b); the LLM tests are NOT members of it
multiplicity.llm_secondary_replication_family: ONE family of 24 tests = 3 evaluators (GPT, Claude, Gemini) x 8 identities; Holm correction across all 24 raw permutation p-values; alpha 0.05
multiplicity.status: secondary cross-evaluator replication evidence; no per-provider or per-identity family may be carved out after results are seen

sensitivities.binned_z: the already frozen semantic binned-Z rule (bin_overall_toxicity, bin_subtype in scripts/civil_comments_freeze.py), one run per evaluator
sensitivities.negative_control: the already frozen negative-control labels (results/civil_comments/negative_control_labels.csv), one run per evaluator; calibration sanity check, never confirmatory

technical_exclusion_audit.when: after all three LLM score stores are frozen
technical_exclusion_audit.what: join per-comment technical/invalid status (not scores) to A and simple covariates (comment length); report overall exclusion rate, exclusion counts by identity, simple association tests (two-sided Fisher exact per identity), and whether missingness threatens interpretation
technical_exclusion_audit.status: missingness audit only; frozen exclusion rules are never modified post hoc

score_store_freeze_procedure: 1. per provider: verify expected coverage (one attempted record per manifest comment id, no duplicates)
2. classify each record ok / technical failure / unparseable under the frozen rules
3. inspect ONLY pooled A-blind quantities (score distribution, failure counts, token/cost totals)
4. RawScoreStore.freeze() writes the SHA-256 manifest; record the store SHA-256 in results
5. only after a provider's store is frozen may that provider's scores be joined to A/Z

cost_accounting.procedure: before the first dataset API call: estimate input/output token volume from A-blind manifest text lengths, estimate per-provider cost from the frozen PERSUADE pricing records (judge.*.pricing_per_mtok), record the estimate in the run log, and verify credentials/model availability with non-dataset smoke calls
cost_accounting.informational_only: the estimate never changes the frozen evaluator family

interpretation_limitations: a rejection means the evaluator score retains residual conditional statistical dependence on an identity-mention attribute among comments with identical observed human toxicity annotation vectors
it does not establish discrimination, unfairness, causal use of identity, demographic inference, or intent
it does not establish that identity language is inherently irrelevant to toxicity in every context, nor that human annotations measure toxicity perfectly

cross-evaluator statements (e.g. 'residual conditional dependence was observed across multiple evaluator architectures') may be made only if the frozen results actually support them; disagreements between Detoxify and LLM evaluators are reported as disagreements, not harmonized
the LLM family is secondary replication evidence and is never described as part of the original PERSUADE preregistration or the original Civil Comments primary confirmatory family
